description: Deletes a thread and everything it holds: every message, the drafts written on it, and the files that came with them, down to the bytes they were stored as. This is FINAL and there is no trash to fish it back out of, so it is not the gesture for tidying an inbox: file_conversation with "trash" is, and it keeps the thread readable and restorable. Use this only when the record itself must not remain, and when the person asking knows that is what they are asking for. The contact fiche stays, and so does the rest of the correspondence with them.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it.

name: delete_conversation
title: Delete a conversation for good
